pages.title: Solar Roof Tiles vs Panels on a Tile Roof in California
pages.note: Title kept (already matches 'solar roof tiles' queries; G07 still held). Meta description now leads with 'solar roofing'. Added: three meanings of solar roofing with the Permitting Guidebook's BIPV and PV-shingle definitions; who may install (CSLB list has no roofing class); fire classification and ASTM D 3161 wind-label checks; Stockton SolarAPP+ BIPV exclusion; how to compare a solar-tile bid with a panel bid via price per watt of the solar share; FAQs on roofers installing solar, 'will a solar company replace my roof' (c100, links to the free-roof page), and whether solar shingles are worth it. No price figures: no primary source publishes current California solar-tile prices.

pages.title: Leasing Your Roof for Solar in California: How It Works
pages.note: Covers the general question, not only LADWP: roof lease vs solar lease vs PPA table, LADWP Solar Rooftops payment table and contract terms (as a benchmark), no equivalent found for PG&E/SCE/SDG&E homes, CPUC community solar as the subscription alternative, LADWP Feed-in Tariff for business roofs (30 kW+, 14.5 c/kWh in-basin 30-500 kW as of 2026-09-18). Kept short on LADWP details and links to /blog/ladwp-solar-rooftops-program to avoid overlap. LADWP pages fetched with curl (WebFetch 403). The holder link from /blog/rent-solar-panels-for-your-home-california is a link_request (costfin owns it).

pages.title: Flat Roof Solar Panels in California: Mounts and Permits
pages.note: Checked first: no residential flat-roof page existed (commercial-solar-roofing covers commercial low-slope and is linked). Residential scope. Ballasted/attached/hybrid table, tilt and soiling, structural/wind/seismic checklist from the 2019 guidebook, membrane protection, permit path (SolarAPP+ excludes ballasted), re-roof timing, alternatives. No price figures. Could not run PVWatts for a tilt comparison: developer.nrel.gov is blocked by the egress proxy.

pages.title: Solar Panel Removal and Reinstall Cost in California
pages.note: 'solar panel removal' (167 impr) and 'solar removal' (146) reach this page, but it only covered remove-and-reinstall. Added removing panels for good (ownership, utility, permit, roof patching, universal-waste disposal), finding a company that removes and reinstalls (CSLB Find My Licensed Contractor, original installer first), partial removal for a roof repair, FAQs on DIY removal and trashing panels. Meta description updated; title kept. Still no price figures: no primary source publishes removal prices. DTSC's PV-module page returns 403 to both WebFetch and curl, so the regulation text (via Cornell LII) and Riverside County's waste department are cited instead.
